name: How long does a remodel painting project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a remodel painting project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a remodel painting project depends on several factors, including the size of the area, the extent of surface preparation required, and the type of paint and finishes chosen. For a standard room, painting might take 2-3 days, while an entire interior house could take 1-2 weeks. Exterior painting projects, depending on weather and house size, can also vary significantly. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing the scope of work during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies based on size, preparation needed, and paint type; typically 2-3 days for a room, or 1-2 weeks for an entire interior.
